title: the gdctx routing guard blocks pipe filters, and its Bash-only matcher lets the native search tool bypass it

tasks.title: Collect remaining context
tasks.dispositionReason: Context came from measuring the shipped guard directly: classifier probed on every specimen, matcher and parseCommand read, refusal exercised end to end.

tasks.title: Implement per plan
tasks.dispositionReason: statements()+firstStages() replace the flat segments() split; nativeSearchTools declared (Grep, not Glob); hook.ts refuses a native search before failing open; matcher widened to Bash|Grep with validate reporting a stale install; repo's own settings.json updated.

tasks.title: Add/adjust tests and make them pass
tasks.dispositionReason: 31 new tests across hook-pipeline and hook-native-search, including the outside proposal's five specimens with the one divergence asserted. Two existing tests rebound from the literal Bash to the exported constant.

tasks.title: Self-review and prepare draft PR
tasks.dispositionReason: Self-review confirmed the expensive direction is guarded: grep -rn foo src/ | head stays blocked, and only the first pipeline stage of each statement is classified so cd x && rg y still fires.
